title: Template Definition
description: Schema for the Android Template Engine template-definition.json file.

name.description: The user-friendly display name of the template (e.g., 'Empty Activity Compose').

short-name.description: The unique identifier for the template, typically written in kebab-case (e.g., 'empty-activity-compose').

description.description: An optional explanation or documentation of the template's purpose and functionality.

comment.description: An optional developer note or comment regarding this template definition.

tags.description: A list of tags used to categorize, filter, or group templates (e.g., ['compose', 'activity']).

schema-version.description: The version of the schema used by this template definition file (e.g., '1.2' or '2.3.4'). This allows template engines to verify if they can process this definition.

arguments.description: The list of dynamic input arguments required when generating files from this template.

items.description: An argument definition specifying a unique ID and its default value.

id.description: The unique identifier for the argument. This ID can be referenced in string interpolation expressions as '${id}'.

description.description: An optional comment or description explaining what this argument is used for.

comment.description: An optional comment or developer note about this argument.

default-value.description: The default value of the argument if no explicit value is provided. Supports string interpolation expressions (e.g., '${package-name.replace('.', '/')}') and built-in methods like '.toLower()'.

dependencies.description: Dependencies, such as Android SDK packages, required by this template.

sdk-package.description: The unique identifier of the required SDK package (e.g., 'platforms;android-33').

description.description: An optional comment or description explaining why this dependency is required.

comment.description: An optional comment or developer note about this dependency.

extra-files.description: List of extra files that must be preloaded, relative to the template root. Paths must be relative, cannot contain '..' or ':' or start with '/' or '\'.

transformations.description: A list of file and directory transformation rules to apply when generating output from the template.

oneOf.description: A string replacement transformation applied to the content of matching template files.

comment.description: An optional comment or developer note for this transformation step.

description.description: An optional explanation or documentation of this transformation step's purpose.

string-replace.description: Replaces all occurrences of a specific string inside the selected files' content. Supports both single-line and multi-line replacement (if either 'from' or 'to' contains a newline, the replacement is applied to the entire file content at once instead of line-by-line).

description.description: An optional description of the string replacement operation.

comment.description: An optional developer note or comment.

selector.description: Specifies which files this transformation applies to.

glob.description: A glob pattern matching relative paths inside the template.

from.description: The literal text string within the selected files to find and replace. Cannot be empty. Can contain newlines for multi-line replacement.

to.description: The replacement string to insert, supporting string interpolation expressions (e.g., '${package-name}'). Can contain newlines for multi-line replacement.

oneOf.description: A file or directory renaming transformation applied to the paths of matching template entries.

comment.description: An optional comment or developer note for this transformation step.

description.description: An optional explanation or documentation of this transformation step's purpose.

rename-file.description: Renames or moves matching files or directories in the generated template output.

description.description: An optional description of the file renaming operation.

comment.description: An optional developer note or comment.

selector.description: Specifies which files or directories this transformation applies to.

glob.description: A glob pattern matching relative paths inside the template.

source-path.description: The exact substring of the relative path that should be replaced. Cannot be empty.

target-path.description: The replacement string for the path segment, supporting string interpolation expressions (e.g., '${package-name.replace('.', '/')}') to dynamically compute the destination directories.
